L107: M Countdown Chart winners (2022)
L108: ---
L109: 【40†BTS】' (pictured) win for "【41†Yet to Come】" had the highest score of 2022 so far, with 11,000 points on the June 23rd broadcast. The song also marked BTS' first Triple Crown on M Countdown.
L110: 
L111: The M Countdown Chart is a 【42†record chart】 on the South Korean 【43†Mnet】 【44†television music program】 【45†M Countdown】. Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【46†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L112: In 2022, 31 singles ranked number one on the chart and 26 music acts received first-place trophies. "【47†Yet to Come】" by 【40†BTS】 had the highest score of the year, with 11,000 points on the June 23 broadcast. Four songs collected trophies for three weeks and achieved a 【48†Triple Crown】: 【49†Big Bang】's "【50†Still Life】", 【40†BTS】' "【47†Yet to Come】", and 【51†Blackpink】's "【52†Pink Venom】" and "【53†Shut Down】".
L113: ## Scoring system
L114: 
L115: [【54†edit】]
L116: 
L117: 【55†Kep1er】 (top) and 【56†NewJeans】 (bottom) won their first ever music show trophies for "【57†Wa Da Da】" and "【58†Attention】," respectively.
L118: 
L119: 【59†Got the Beat】 (pictured) earned their first M Countdown trophy for "【60†Step Back】."
L120: 
L121: 【61†Wheein】 of 【62†Mamamoo】 (left), 【63†Yena】 (middle), and 【64†Jin】 of 【40†BTS】 (right) won their first ever music show trophies as soloists with their awards for "Make Me Happy," "Smiley," and "【65†The Astronaut】," respectively.
L122: 【66†Viviz】 (top), 【67†Ive】 (second from top), 【68†Fromis 9】 (third from top), and 【69†Aespa】 (bottom) won their first M Countdown trophies with "【70†Bop Bop!】," "【71†Love Dive】," "【72†Stay This Way】," and "【73†Girls】," respectively.
L123: 
L124: 【74†Lim Young-woong】 (left) and 【75†Nayeon】 of 【76†Twice】 (right) won their first M Countdown trophies as soloists with their awards for "If We Ever Meet Again" and "【77†Pop!】," respectively.
